072        Room vOffice = new Room("in the office", "Images/Office.jpg");
073        
074        // 2nd floor

076        Room vBedroom = new Room("in the bedroom", "Images/Bedroom.jpg");
077        Room vBathroom = new Room("in the bathroom", "Images/Bathroom.jpg");
078        
079        // basement 
080        Room vCellar = new Room("in the cellar", "Images/Cellar.jpg");
081        
082        // special
083        Room vMirror = new Room("mirror", null);
084        
085        // setting exits
086        vHall.setExit("east", vDiningRoom, false);
087        vHall.setExit("west", vLivingRoom, false);
088        vHall.setExit("up", vHall2, false);

090        vDiningRoom.setExit("north", vKitchen, false);
091        vDiningRoom.setExit("west", vHall, false);
092        
093        vKitchen.setExit("south", vDiningRoom, false);
094        vKitchen.setExit("down", vCellar, false);
095        
096        vLivingRoom.setExit("north", vOffice, false);

099        vOffice.setExit("east", vKitchen, true); // one way exit

102        vHall2.setExit("north", vBedroom, true); // locked by red key

104        vHall2.setExit("down", vHall, false);
105        
106        vBedroom.setExit("south", vHall2, false);

108        vBathroom.setExit("west", vHall2, false);
109        
110        vCellar.setExit("up", vKitchen, false);

112        // adjusting doors

116        // adjusting lights

233    /**
234     * Given a command, process (that is: execute) the command.
235     * If this command ends the game, true is returned, otherwise false is
236     * returned.
237     * 
238     * @param pCommandLine Text input by user
239     */
240    public void interpretCommand( final String pCommandLine ) 
241    {
242        this.aGui.println( "> " + pCommandLine );
243        Command vCommand = this.aParser.getCommand( pCommandLine );
244
245        if ( vCommand.isUnknown() ) {
246            this.aGui.println( "I don't know what you mean..." );
247            return;
248        }
249
250        String vCommandWord = vCommand.getCommandWord();
251        if ( vCommandWord.equals( "help" ) )
252            this.printHelp();
253        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "go" ) )
254            this.goRoom( vCommand );
255        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "use" ) ) 
256            this.use( vCommand );
257        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "look" ) ) {
258            this.look( vCommand );
259        }
260        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "inventory" ) ) {
261            this.showInventory();
262        }
263        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "take" ) ) {
264            this.take( vCommand );
265        }
266        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "drop" ) ) {
267            this.drop( vCommand );
268        }
269        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "back" ) ) {
270            this.back();
271        }     
272        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "exit" ) ) {
273            this.exit();
274        }     
275        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "quit" ) ) {
276            if ( vCommand.hasSecondWord() )
277                this.aGui.println( "Quit what?" );
278            else {   
279                this.aGui.showImage( "Images/ThankYouForPlaying.jpg" );
280                this.endGame();
281            }
282        }
283        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "test" ) ) {
284            this.test( vCommand );
285        }
286        else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "alea" ) ) {
287            this.alea( vCommand );
288        }
289        this.moveNpc();
290    }

303    /**
304     * @param pDirection String indicating next room 
305     */
306    private void goRoom(final Command pDirection)
307    {
308        if(pDirection.hasSecondWord() == false){
309            this.aGui.println("Go where ?" + "\n");
310            return;
311        }
312        
313        String vDirection = pDirection.getSecondWord();
314        
315        if ( vDirection.equals("back") ) this.back(); // pour autoriser "go back"
316        
317        Room vNextRoom = this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getExit(vDirection);
318        
319        // Testing if the second word is a valid direction :
320        if(vNextRoom == null){
321            this.aGui.println("You can't go this way.");
322            this.aGui.print("\n");
323            return;
324        }
325        
326        if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().hasDoor(vDirection) ) { 
327            if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().directionLocked(vDirection) ) {
328                if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("on the second floor")) {
329                    if (this.itemInInventory("red_key")) {
330                        this.aGui.println("You unlocked the door with the red key.");
331                        this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDoor(vDirection).unlockDoor();
332                        this.goRoom(pDirection);
333                        return;
334                    }
335                }
336                this.aGui.print("\n");
337                this.aGui.println("The door is locked.");
338                this.aGui.print("\n");
339                return;
340            }
341            
342            if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDoor(vDirection).isOneWay() ){
343                this.aPlayer1.deletePreviousRooms();
344            }
345        }
346        
347        this.aPlayer1.goNextRoom( vNextRoom );
348        
349        if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("mirror") ) {
350            this.aPlayer1.deletePreviousRooms(); // empecher back()
351            this.goRandom();
352        }
353        
354        this.printLocationInfo();
355        if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getImageName() != null ) 
356            this.aGui.showImage( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getImageName() );
357        
358        if ( this.aPlayer1.isOverMaxWeight() ) {
359            this.suspicion( 10 );
360            this.aGui.println("You are carrying too much.");
361            this.aGui.println("You make noise while moving." + "\n");
362        }
363    }// goRoom(.)
364    
365    private void goRandom()
366    {
367        Random r = new Random();
368        int vN = r.nextInt( this.aRandRooms.size() + 1 ); // genere un int aleatoire
369        Room vDestination;
370        if (this.aAlea != null) vDestination = this.aRoomList.get(this.aAlea);
371        else vDestination = this.aRandRooms.get(vN); // choisis une Room aleatoire en fonction de l'int
372        this.aPlayer1.goNextRoom( vDestination ); 
373    }// goRandom()

388    private void use(final Command pAction)
389    {
390        if(pAction.hasSecondWord() == false) {
391            this.aGui.print("\n");
392            this.aGui.println("Use what ? ");
393            this.aGui.print("\n");
394            return;
395        }
396        
397        String vAction = pAction.getSecondWord();
398        if ( vAction.equals("switch") || vAction.equals("lights") ) {
399            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().switchLights() ) {
400                this.aGui.println("lights on");
401                this.aGui.print("\n");
402            }
403            else {
404                this.aGui.println("lights off");
405                this.aGui.print("\n");
406            }
407        }
408        else if ( vAction.equals("Spotion") ) {
409            if ( this.itemInInventory("Spotion") ) {
410                this.aGui.print("\n");
411                this.aGui.println("You drink the strength potion.");
412                this.aGui.println("Your Max Weight increases!");
413                this.aGui.print("\n");
414                this.aPlayer1.addMaxWeight(100);
415            }
416            else return;
417        }
418        else if ( vAction.equals("tablet") ) {
419            if ( this.itemInInventory("tablet") ) {
420                if ( this.aTabletCharge == null ) {
421                    this.aGui.print("\n");
422                    this.aGui.println("You use the strange stone tablet.");
423                    this.aGui.println("The runes light up but nothing happens...");
424                    this.aGui.print("\n");
425                    this.aTabletCharge = this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom();
426                }
427                else {
428                    this.aGui.print("\n");
429                    this.aGui.println("You use the strange stone tablet again.");
430                    this.aGui.println("You are surrounded by bright light.");
431                    this.aGui.println("You open your eyes and find yourself in the room where you first used the tablet.");
432                    this.aGui.print("\n");
433                    this.aPlayer1.goNextRoom( this.aTabletCharge );
434                    this.printLocationInfo();
435                    if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getImageName() != null ) 
436                        this.aGui.showImage( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getImageName() );
437                    this.aTabletCharge = null;
438                }
439            }
440        }
441        else if ( vAction.equals("water_bucket") ) {
442            if ( this.itemInInventory("water_bucket") ) {
443                this.aGui.print("\n");
444                this.aGui.println("You drink the stagnant water bucket.");
445                this.aGui.println("You are feeling unwell...");
446                this.aGui.println("...\n...\n...");
447                this.aGui.println("You have died of dysentery.");
448                this.aGui.showImage( "Images/dysentry.jpg" );
449                this.aGui.print("\n");
450                this.endGame();
451            }
452        }
453        else if ( vAction.equals("rat") ) {
454            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals( "in the living room" )) {
455                if ( this.itemInInventory("rat") ) {
456                    this.aGui.print("\n");
457                    this.aGui.println("You give the rat to the cat.");
458                    this.aGui.println("The cat eats it and runs away");
459                    this.aGui.println("...\n...\n...");
460                    this.aGui.println("There is a pearl left where the cat was sitting.");
461                    this.aGui.print("\n");
462                    this.aRoomList.get("LivingRoom").addItem("pearl", "a shiny pearl", 10, 70);
463                }
464            }
465        }
466    }// use(.)

485    /**
486     * @param pAction Command object indicating what the character is looking at
487     */
488    private void look(final Command pAction)
489    {   
490        if(pAction.hasSecondWord() == false) {
491            this.printLocationInfo();
492            return;
493        }
494        
495        String vAction = pAction.getSecondWord();
496        if (vAction.equals("item") || vAction.equals( "items" )) {
497            if( !this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getLights() ) { // tester si on peut voir
498                this.aGui.print("\n");
499                this.aGui.println("It's too dark.");
500                this.aGui.println("You can't see anything. ");
501                this.aGui.print("\n");
502                return;
503            }
504            
505            this.aGui.println( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getItemsDescription() );
506            this.aGui.println("\n");
507            return;
508        }
509        else if (vAction.equals("inventory")) {
510            this.showInventory();
511        }
512        else if (vAction.equals("wardrobe")) {
513            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("in the bedroom")) {
514                this.aGui.println("There is a strange mirror inside the wardrobe.");
515                this.aGui.println("It's almost as if you could walk inside..." + "\n");
516                this.aRoomList.get("Bedroom").setExit("mirror", aRoomList.get("Mirror"), false);
517                this.printLocationInfo();
518            }
519            else this.aGui.println("What do you want to look at ?" + "\n");
520        }
521        else if (vAction.equals("desk")) {
522            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("in the office")) {
523                this.aGui.println("You find a few items in the desk's drawers." + "\n"); 
524                this.aRoomList.get("Office").addItem("tablet", "a strange stone tablet", 50, 150);
525                this.aRoomList.get("Office").addItem("coin_pouch", "a large coin pouch", 20, 200);
526                this.aRoomList.get("Office").addItem("Spotion", "a strengthening potion", 10, 400);
527                this.printLocationInfo();
528            }
529            else this.aGui.println("What do you want to look at ?" + "\n");
530        }
531        else if (vAction.equals("chest")) {
532            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("in the bedroom")) {
533                this.aGui.println("You find gold ingots in the chest !" + "\n"); 
534                this.aRoomList.get("Bedroom").addItem("ingots", "a pile of golden ingots", 200, 1000);
535                this.printLocationInfo();
536            }
537            else this.aGui.println("What do you want to look at ?" + "\n");
538        }
539        else if (vAction.equals("cat")) {
540            if (this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals("in the living room")) {
541                this.aGui.println("The cat looks hungry." + "\n"); 
542                this.printLocationInfo();
543            }
544            else this.aGui.println("What do you want to look at ?" + "\n");
545        }
546        else this.aGui.println("What do you want to look at ?" + "\n");
547    }

549    private void showInventory()
550    {
551        if ( this.aPlayer1.emptyInv() ) {
552            this.aGui.print("\n");
553            this.aGui.println("Your inventory is empty.");
554            this.aGui.print("\n");
555            return;
556        }
557        
558        String vS = this.aPlayer1.itemList();
559        String[] vItems = vS.split("\\W+");

566    /**
567     * @param pCommand Command object indicating the item
568     */
569    private void take(final Command pCommand)
570    {
571        if(pCommand.hasSecondWord() == false) {
572            this.aGui.print("\n");
573            this.aGui.println("Take what ? ");
574            this.aGui.print("\n");
575            return;
576        }
577        
578        String vItemName = pCommand.getSecondWord();
579        
580        if (vItemName.equals("rat")) {
581            if ( this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getDescription().equals( this.aNpcList.get("rat").getCurrentRoom().getDescription() ) ) {
582                this.aPlayer1.pickUpItem(new Item("rat", "a dead rat", 10, 0));
583                this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().removeNpc("rat");
584                this.aNpcList.remove("rat");
585                this.aGui.print("\n");
586                this.aGui.println("You have caught the rat. ");
587                this.aGui.print("\n");
588                return;
589            }
590        }
591        
592        try { 
593            Item vItem = this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().getItem(vItemName);
594            boolean vWeight = this.aPlayer1.pickUpItem(vItem);
595            this.aPlayer1.getCurrentRoom().removeItem(vItemName); //retire l'objet de la Room
596        
597            this.aGui.print("\n");
598            this.aGui.println("You have taken the " + vItemName + ".");
599            this.aGui.print("\n");
600            
601            if ( vWeight ) {
602                this.aGui.print("\n");
603                this.aGui.println("You are carrying too may items. ");
604                this.aGui.print("\n");
605            }
606        }
607        catch (Exception vE) {
608            this.aGui.print("\n");
609            this.aGui.println("there is no " + vItemName + " here.");
610            this.aGui.print("\n");
611        }
612    }

614    /**

616     */
617    private void drop(final Command pCommand)
618    {
619        if(pCommand.hasSecondWord() == false) {
620            this.aGui.print("\n");

622            this.aGui.print("\n");
623            return;

625        
626        String vItemName = pCommand.getSecondWord();
627        try { 
628            Item vItem = this.aPlayer1.searchInventory(vItemName);

630            this.aPlayer1.dropItem(vItem);
631            
632            this.aGui.print("\n");
633            this.aGui.println("You have dropped the " + vItemName + ".");
634            this.aGui.print("\n");
635        }
636        catch (Exception vE) {
637            this.aGui.print("\n");
638            this.aGui.println("there is no " + vItemName + " in your inventory.");
639            this.aGui.print("\n");
640        }
641    }

643    /**
644     * permet de lancer un test
645     * 
646     * @param pFichier nom du fichier txt contenant les instructions ligne par ligne
647     */
648    private void test(final Command pFichier)
649    {
650        if(pFichier.hasSecondWord() == false) {
651            this.aGui.print("\n");
652            this.aGui.println( "test what ?" );
653            this.aGui.print("\n");
654            return;
655        }
656        
657        Scanner vSc;
658        String vFichier = pFichier.getSecondWord();
659        
660        try {
661            vSc = new Scanner( new File( vFichier + ".txt" ) );
662            while ( vSc.hasNextLine() ) {
663                String vLine = vSc.nextLine();
664                this.interpretCommand( vLine );
665            }
666        }
667        catch ( final FileNotFoundException pNF ) {
668            this.aGui.print("\n");
669            this.aGui.println( "test not found" );
670            this.aGui.print("\n");
671        }
672    }// test(.)

674    /**
675     * commande pour truquer les tirages aleatoires
676     * n'est utilisee que dans les tests
677     */
678    private void alea( final Command pCommand ) // commande reservee aux tests
679    {
680        if (pCommand.hasSecondWord()) {
681            String vS = pCommand.getSecondWord();
682            this.aAlea = vS;
683        }
684        else this.aAlea = null;
685    }

689    private void suspicion(final int pSuspicion)
690    {
691        this.aSuspicion = this.aSuspicion + pSuspicion;
692        if (this.aSuspicion >= 50) this.lose();
693    }
